BrochureContent.Content:
Clonainey, Kilsallaghan is a stunning three-bedroom, energy efficient home that has been extended and upgraded with great care and attention. Extending to an impressive 235 sq.m. (2,530 sq.ft.) and boasting unique features, this idyllic family home is set on a private 0.5 acre site of beautifully manicured gardens. On inspection the viewer will be impressed with the comprehensive list of high-quality finishes both inside and out. Large windows offer stunning views of the gardens and flood the property with natural light. Kilsallaghan, Swords combines quiet country living with the benefit of all amenities close by. Conveniently located only minutes’ drive to Swords Main Street, Ballyboughal and Rolestown Villages, Dublin Airport, M1 & M50 motorways. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the quality of accommodation on offer.

* Impressive, beautifully landscaped 0.5 acre site
* Spacious light filled accommodation throughout
* Energy efficient ‘B3’ rated home
* Large, bright dining room with high ceiling and Velux windows
* Main bedroom with en suite, home office and walk in wardrobe
* Three double bedrooms
* Utility room
* Block built garage 6.6m x 5.8m
* Steel sheds x 2 - 5.6m x 4.8m
* Electric entrance gates
* Solar panels
* Oil fired central heating
* Landscaped gardens include water feature and pond
* Private, picturesque rural setting
* Double glazed windows throughout
* Burglar alarm and CCTV fitted
* Septic tank
* Only minutes’ drive to Swords Main Street, Dublin Airport, M1 & M50
